quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You forgot to do your homework and your teacher is asking for it now.
quests.hint: You knew you were supposed to do something and you did not.
quests.explanation: When you forget to do something you were responsible for you feel guilty.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You are sitting on an airplane for the very first time in your life.
quests.hint: This is a new experience high above the ground!
quests.explanation: Flying for the first time makes most people feel nervous.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your favorite toy breaks and cannot be fixed.
quests.hint: Something you loved is gone forever.
quests.explanation: When something you care about is broken and cannot be fixed you feel upset.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You see a small child crying because he is lost in a shop.
quests.hint: A small child needs help and is clearly very upset.
quests.explanation: Seeing a lost crying child makes you feel concerned.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You walk in the door and your friends all shout Surprise!
quests.hint: You had absolutely no idea this was going to happen!
quests.explanation: When something completely unexpected happens you feel surprised.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You finally finish a big school project you worked on for two weeks.
quests.hint: A long stressful task is finally done!
quests.explanation: Completing a big project after hard work makes you feel relieved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You have to wait in a very long slow-moving queue at the supermarket.
quests.hint: You want to leave but you cannot go yet.
quests.explanation: Standing in a long slow queue makes you feel impatient.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your friend says That was a really great idea you had!
quests.hint: Someone said something kind and positive about you.
quests.explanation: Receiving a compliment from a friend makes you feel happy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A large spider suddenly runs across the floor in your bedroom.
quests.hint: Many people have a strong fear of spiders.
quests.explanation: Seeing a large spider unexpectedly makes many people feel terrified.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally drop a heavy book in a completely silent library.
quests.hint: The loud noise made everyone in the library look at you.
quests.explanation: Making a loud noise in a quiet place makes you feel embarrassed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your school team wins the regional championship!
quests.hint: Your team worked so hard and won the top prize!
quests.explanation: Winning a championship after hard work makes you feel thrilled.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally bite into a whole lemon thinking it was an orange.
quests.hint: The taste is very strong sour and unexpected!
quests.explanation: Biting into something extremely sour by accident makes you feel shocked.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your alarm clock rings at 6 AM for an early morning class.
quests.hint: It is very early and you were fast asleep just a moment ago.
quests.explanation: Waking up very early when you are still tired makes you feel sleepy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A classmate invites you to sit together at lunchtime.
quests.hint: Someone wants to be friendly and spend time with you.
quests.explanation: Being invited to sit with someone is a friendly gesture that makes you feel happy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You watch a film where the main character dies at the very end.
quests.hint: Something very sad and emotional just happened in the story.
quests.explanation: When a character you care about dies in a film you feel moved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The electricity goes out suddenly in the middle of the night.
quests.hint: Everything is dark and quiet and you do not know why.
quests.explanation: A sudden power cut at night makes you feel unsettled.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You cook a simple meal completely by yourself for the first time.
quests.hint: You did something new and useful completely on your own!
quests.explanation: Successfully doing something for the first time like cooking makes you feel accomplished.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You bump into an old friend on the street who you have not seen for five years.
quests.hint: You did not expect to see this person here at all!
quests.explanation: Unexpectedly meeting an old friend makes you feel pleasantly surprised.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You get a haircut and you really do not like the way it looks.
quests.hint: You have to show everyone a style you do not like.
quests.explanation: Getting a haircut you dislike makes you feel embarrassed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your family sets off on a long road trip to the mountains.
quests.hint: Adventure and beautiful scenery are waiting for you!
quests.explanation: Starting a trip to a beautiful place with your family makes you feel excited.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your neighbour leaves a handwritten thank-you card in your letterbox.
quests.hint: Someone took the time to write something kind just for you.
quests.explanation: Receiving a handwritten card from someone makes you feel touched.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally knock your drink off the table at a restaurant.
quests.hint: An accident happened in a public place and everyone noticed.
quests.explanation: Accidentally making a mess in public makes you feel flustered.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You sit and watch the sun set slowly over the ocean.
quests.hint: Beautiful natural scenery can calm your mind and body.
quests.explanation: Watching a beautiful sunset over the water creates a feeling of peace.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You apply to join a school club but you are not selected.
quests.hint: You tried hard but you were not chosen this time.
quests.explanation: Being rejected from something you applied for makes you feel discouraged.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A stranger picks up your wallet when you drop it and returns it.
quests.hint: Someone helped you without expecting anything in return.
quests.explanation: When a stranger helps you you feel grateful.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Today is your first day at a new part-time job.
quests.hint: You do not know anyone and everything is brand new.
quests.explanation: Starting a new job makes most people feel nervous.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: After heavy rain a rainbow appears in the sky.
quests.hint: A beautiful colourful natural wonder has appeared!
quests.explanation: Seeing a rainbow makes most people feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You say something by mistake that hurts your friend's feelings.
quests.hint: You did not mean to hurt anyone but you did.
quests.explanation: Accidentally hurting someone's feelings makes you feel guilty.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You sit in the dentist's waiting room for 45 minutes.
quests.hint: Time is passing very slowly and you want to leave.
quests.explanation: Waiting for a long time especially at the dentist makes you feel impatient.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You pass a very difficult exam after studying extremely hard.
quests.hint: The stress and hard work have finally paid off!
quests.explanation: Passing a difficult exam after lots of studying makes you feel relieved.
